_doc: DEP-06 "What a yield must say" (yield-evidence-v9, DEP-18; ruled 2026-11-23). Under yield-evidence-v9 a DisputeYield carries exactly one reason, each 32 bytes: lost_to (TLV 367, a claim txid), reestablished (TLV 369, a QuorumBegin update's content_hash), excluded_by (TLV 371, a confiscation or re-arm spend txid), superseded_by (TLV 373, the content_hash of the yielder's own later DisputeEnter; ruled 2026-11-24). `wire`: the DisputeYield operation's encoding with each reason (hashes as here: txids in display hex are stored as their wire bytes, i.e. reversed; the reestablished and superseded_by hashes as written). `cases`: `fold` is whether a fork under `ruleset` takes the yield (structural: exactly one reason under yield-evidence-v9, anything under an earlier ruleset). `verdict` (valid | invalid | pending) and `why` are the judge's answer, checked in this order: legacy (ruleset without the rule) -> no-reason; lost_to: unconfirmed (unknown or no height), early (its height > yield_height), then the acquire_binding judgment against `vaults` (unconfirmed | not-a-claim | not-this-lottery), earlier-round (the round it closes < arm_round), own-claim (output 0 pays one of the yielder's `targets` or input 1 spends one of its `pledges`); reestablished: not-expiry (the dispute's reason is not quorum_expired), unknown-quorum-begin, not-after-fork-point (seq <= last_valid_sequence), rotation-unconfirmed; excluded_by: unconfirmed, early, the lottery's round walked back like a claim's input (the named tx spends a vault: round 1; a confirmed re-arm-shaped tx spending output 0 of the previous: one more; else not-this-lottery), earlier-round, in-lottery (the yielder's xonly is among `participants`, the set the judge rebuilt for that lottery); superseded_by: armed (arm_round > 0: the fork armed), unknown-dispute-enter (not among `enters`, the DisputeEnters the judge holds), other-disputant (`by` is not the yielder), other-ledger (`ledger` is not the case's), not-later (a punitive entry, reason not quorum_expired, at a seq below fork_enter_seq, the yielded fork's own DisputeEnter; an expiry entry at a seq not above it), not-on-ledger. txs: `height` null = unconfirmed; `outputs` are scriptPubKeys (hex). arm_round is the yielder's latest arm's round before the yield. Shared by the spec, deposits-rust (deposits-core/tests/vectors/yield_evidence.json) and cl-deposits (inspect/vectors/yield_evidence.json).

lost_to naming the yielder's own claim (output 0 pays its target_reserves)
lost_to naming the yielder's own claim (input 1 spends its declared collateral)
lost_to naming a claim that does not bind (another lottery's output)
lost_to naming a re-arm spend, not a claim
lost_to naming a claim for an earlier round than the yielder's arm
lost_to naming a round-2 claim, the yielder armed round 2
lost_to naming a claim that confirmed after the yield was signed: early
lost_to naming an unconfirmed claim: no verdict yet
c8b9b7b1 under yield-evidence-v9: ref7's round-2 yield could name only its own later claim
reestablished: a QuorumBegin after the fork point, rotation spend confirmed
reestablished naming a QuorumBegin at the fork point, not after it
reestablished whose rotation spend is unconfirmed: no verdict yet
reestablished naming a QuorumBegin the judge does not hold: no verdict yet
reestablished on a punitive dispute: a rotation does not end it
excluded_by: the confiscation's lottery, the yielder not among its participants
excluded_by naming a lottery the yielder is in
excluded_by: a round-2 re-arm spend's lottery, the yielder armed round 2 and is not in it
excluded_by naming round 1's lottery when the yielder armed round 2
excluded_by naming a transaction that is not this dispute's lottery
superseded_by: an un-armed fork, our punitive DisputeEnter on the same ledger, on the ledger
superseded_by: our later expiry DisputeEnter (a higher sequence) on the same ledger
superseded_by on a fork that armed
superseded_by naming another disputant's DisputeEnter
superseded_by naming a DisputeEnter of another ledger
superseded_by naming a DisputeEnter at a lower sequence
superseded_by naming an expiry DisputeEnter at the same sequence (not a later one)
superseded_by naming a DisputeEnter that is not on the ledger
superseded_by naming a DisputeEnter the judge does not hold: no verdict yet
superseded_by with a second reason: the fold refuses it
superseded_by under strict-lottery-v8 is not judged
no reason under yield-evidence-v9: the fold refuses it
two reasons under yield-evidence-v9: the fold refuses it
no reason under strict-lottery-v8: accepted, judged as before
a reason under strict-lottery-v8 is not judged (even one that would fail)
